body.message:
Yes, it is confirmed, Mr. Muhammad.

However, please note that if you would like to secure the unit for 3 months at the same agreed rate, you will need to make payment for the first month's rent and at least 50% of the last month's rent in advance.

This will allow us to reserve the unit and guarantee the same rate for the full 3-month period. Otherwise, any future extension rates will be subject to market conditions and may change.

Thank you for your understanding.
